why: The one designated breaking commit: its footer makes every dry run from here compute 3.0.0 (the gate refuses it until the owner's GA=1), and it pre-allocates every export, barrel and dependency so package.json stops being a shared hot file. CLI verbs and docs-format follow in v3-rel-7-skeleton-cli.
what: Additive skeleton in packages/basalt-ui: stub barrels, exports map, dependencies and peers, extended 2.x gates, regenerated llms.txt. 2.x keeps compiling, nothing is deleted. Size l by exception: about 17 files are 1-3 line stubs; under 600 lines or signal.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 4.1 step 7 (contract files: v3-rel-7-contracts), 4.3; docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md 2, 3 (twelve runtime subpaths, dependencies). Tooling and CSS subpaths: docs/v3/concepts/{static-framework-free,guardrails,quality-contract}.md. Stubs import no peer. Gap: signal, reversible default.
exemplar: None: first of its kind. packages/basalt-ui/scripts/check-budgets.ts shows the 2.x gate this extends.
change: (1) Stub `export {}` barrels with a JSDoc naming subpath and peers: src/<name>/index.ts for ./router ./data ./page ./cards ./ai ./lint ./testing and ./ui/* (wildcard entry); a ./shell exports key that points at 2.x src/shell/index.tsx until v3-shell-i5 swaps the barrel; ./stylelint src/lint/stylelint/index.ts; ./theme-script src/css/theme-script.ts; ./{tokens,typography,prose,fonts,tailwind}.css src/css/<name>.css. (2) package.json: add those exports, keep every 2.x key; `dependencies` clsx, class-variance-authority, eventsource-parser (npm view, caret); tailwindcss (exact) and @base-ui/react (tilde) as dev deps and optional peers. (3) Extend the 2.x gates: SURFACES rows, export-surface.json, pack-test subpath loop, required-peers (2.x required set unchanged; new peers must be optional), check-budgets `subpaths` 15 -> 30 (`v3 skeleton` comment; consumers: rollhook for CSS, lint, testing; linewatch for ui, page, cards, data, router; ratchets down as 2.x subpaths retire). (4) `files` gains `docs/` so recipes and docs/<export>.md ship. (5) Regenerate llms.txt: bun packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-llms.ts. Build stays tsup.
commits: First commit `feat:`, packages/basalt-ui/ only, footer exactly `BREAKING CHANGE: opens the v3 line; each 2.x API retires with a migration row`. No other commit carries `!` or that footer. A root tsconfig change is a separate non-package commit. No attribution.
acceptance: make check passes (incl. pack-test and gen-llms --check). Reviewed deep.
jq '.exports|keys' packages/basalt-ui/package.json contains every subpath in change (1) and every 2.x key it had; every target resolves in the packed tarball (pack-test).
clsx, class-variance-authority and eventsource-parser are under dependencies; each added peer is optional; the 2.x required-peer set is unchanged.
git log --format=%B origin/master..HEAD | grep -c '^BREAKING CHANGE:' prints 1, no subject contains '!:', no footer line exceeds 100 chars.
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD lists nothing under src/cli, no contract.ts and no MIGRATING.md.
out_of_scope: CLI verbs, docs-format, deleting 2.x sources, Mantine removal, unhot, contracts, docs slimming.
post_merge: Orchestrator, after merge on a clean master: `make release-dry` computes 3.0.0 and the gate refuses it without GA=1.
